'''Berta Miquel''' (born 26 March 2006) is an Andorran individual [[Rhythmic gymnastics|rhythmic gymnast]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=MIQUEL Berta - FIG Athlete Profile |url=https://www.gymnastics.sport/site/athletes/bio_detail.php?id=75728 |access-date=2022-11-21 |website=[[International Gymnastics Federation]]}}</ref> She represents her country in international competitions and is the first Andorran gymnast to qualify for a final at an [[International Gymnastics Federation]] (FIG) competition.

== Personal life ==
Miquel participated in several sports as a child and took up gymnastics at age six after having seen the [[World Gymnaestrada]]. She chose rhythmic gymnastics because she thought it was more elegant and would allow her to perform more.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Sansaloni |first=David |date=2022-01-22 |title=Berta Miquel: «Mentre continuï tenint il·lusió i motivació seguiré donant-ho tot» |trans-title=Berta Miquel: "As long as I continue to have enthusiasm and motivation, I will continue to give everything." |url=https://www.elperiodic.ad/entrevista/90576/mentre-continui-tenint-illusio-i-motivacio-seguire-donant-ho-tot |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220126234413/https://www.elperiodic.ad/entrevista/90576/mentre-continui-tenint-illusio-i-motivacio-seguire-donant-ho-tot |archive-date=2022-01-26 |access-date=2022-11-21 |website=El Periòdic d'Andorra |language=ca}}</ref> She began to train more intensively at age 12,<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last= |date=2025-05-31 |title=To be able to compete against gymnasts of such level and come away with three silver medals is an enormous reward for all the effort that has been invested, said Andorran gymnast, Berta Miquel |url=https://all-andorra.com/andorran-gymnast-berta-miquel/ |access-date=2025-06-18 |website=All Pyrenees |language=en-US}}</ref> and she trains seven hours a day most days of the week.<ref name=":1" />

== Career ==
Miquel's first major competition was the [[2020 Rhythmic Gymnastics European Championships|2020 European Championships]] in [[Kyiv]], where she computed as a junior. She finished 23rd in the all-around.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-11-29 |title=36th European Rhythmic Gymnastics Result Book |url=https://www.gymnastics.sport/asset.php?id=fidb_10716 |website=[[International Gymnastics Federation]]}}</ref>

She debuted as a senior gymnast at the 2022 [[2022 FIG Rhythmic Gymnastics World Cup series|World Cup]] in [[Pamplona]]. She was 26th in the all-around.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Gymnastics - World Cup Rhythmic Gymnastics - Pamplona 2022 - Results |url=https://www.the-sports.org/gymnastics-world-cup-rhythmic-gymnastics-pamplona-results-2022-epr120884.html |access-date=2022-11-21 |website=www.the-sports.org}}</ref> A month later, she took part in the [[2022 Rhythmic Gymnastics European Championships|European Championships]] in [[Tel Aviv]] with teammate [[Maria Gonzalez (Andorran gymnast)|Maria Gonzalez]]. She ended in 57th place in the all-around with her best result being 44th with ribbon.<ref>{{Cite web |title=2022 European Championships Nominative Applications |url=https://backend.europeangymnastics.com/sites/default/files/paragraph/document/Nominative_applications_38th_ECh_RG_Tel_Aviv_20220523.pdf |website=[[European Gymnastics]] |format=PDF}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=European Rhythmic Gymnastics Championships 2022 - Results Women |url=https://www.the-sports.org/gymnastics-european-rhythmic-gymnastics-championships-results-2022-women-epf120870.html#549944 |access-date=2022-11-21 |website=www.the-sports.org}}</ref>

In August, she competed at the World Cup in [[Cluj-Napoca]], ending 40th in the all-around.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Gymnastics - World Cup Rhythmic Gymnastics - Cluj-Napoca 2022 - Results |url=https://www.the-sports.org/gymnastics-world-cup-rhythmic-gymnastics-cluj-napoca-results-2022-epr122882.html#564194 |access-date=2022-11-21 |website=www.the-sports.org}}</ref> The next month, she competed at the [[2022 Rhythmic Gymnastics World Championships|World Gymnastics Championships]] in [[Sofia]], and was 70th place in the all-around.<ref>{{Cite web |title=World Rhythmic Gymnastics Championships 2022 - Results Women |url=https://www.the-sports.org/gymnastics-world-rhythmic-gymnastics-championships-results-2022-women-epf122880.html#565858 |access-date=2022-11-21 |website=www.the-sports.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-09-18 |title=2022 World Championships Result Book |url=https://gym.longinestiming.com/File/0000140001FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF02 |website=Longines Timing |format=PDF}}</ref>

Miquel competed at the [[2023 Rhythmic Gymnastics European Championships|2023 European Championships]], where she placed 53rd.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Results for 39th Senior European Championships Baku (AZE) |url=https://www.gymnastics.sport/site/events/results.php?idEvent=17269 |access-date=2025-06-18 |website=[[International Gymnastics Federation]]}}</ref> At the [[2023 Rhythmic Gymnastics World Championships|2023 World Championships]] in [[Valencia]], she finished in 73rd place.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Results for 40th FIG Rhythmic Gymnastics World Championships Valencia (ESP) |url=https://www.gymnastics.sport/site/events/results.php?idEvent=16307 |access-date=2025-06-18 |website=[[International Gymnastics Federation]]}}</ref>

In April 2024, Miquel became the first Andorran gymnast to qualify for a final in a FIG competition at the Ritam Cup in [[Belgrade]], where she qualified for the ribbon final.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |date=2024-04-29 |title=Berta Miquel entra a una final per primer cop |trans-title=Berta Miquel enters a final for the first time |url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/240429/berta-miquel-entra-final-per-primer-cop_150008.html |access-date=2025-06-18 |website=Diari d'Andorra |language=ca}}</ref> She went on to compete at the [[2024 Rhythmic Gymnastics European Championships|European Championships]] and finished in 58th place.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Results for 40th Senior European Championships Budapest (HUN) |url=https://www.gymnastics.sport/site/events/results.php?idEvent=17276 |access-date=2025-06-18 |website=[[International Gymnastics Federation]]}}</ref>

The next year, in May, Miquel competed at the [[2025 Games of the Small States of Europe]], held in her home country. She won three silver medals, one in the all-around and two in the ball and ribbon apparatus finals.<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-31 |title=Schedule and results - Games of the Small States of Europe |url=https://gsse-andorra2025.com/en/schedule-and-results/ |access-date=2025-06-18 |website=Andorra 2025}}</ref> She expressed surprise at having won the medals, as she had not expected to be in medal contention.<ref name=":1" /> The next month, she competed at the [[2025 Rhythmic Gymnastics European Championships|European Championships]], where she placed 54th.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |date=2025-06-12 |title=Bona actuació de Berta Miquel a l'Europeu |trans-title=Good performance by Berta Miquel in Europe |url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/250612/bona-actuacio-berta-miquel-l-europeu_174800.html |access-date=2025-06-18 |website=Diari d'Andorra |language=ca}}</ref> In August, she participated to the [[2025 Rhythmic Gymnastics World Championships|2025 World Championships]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]], placing 68th in the all-around and getting her best score with hoop.<ref>{{Cite web |title=2025 Rhythmic Gymnastics World Championships Rio de Janeiro |url=https://gym.longinestiming.com/2025/Rhythmic-17647/en-us/Default |access-date=2026-08-31 |website=Longines Timing}}</ref>

Her 2026 international season started with her participation at the [[2026 FIG Rhythmic Gymnastics World Cup series|World Cup]] in [[Sofia]] in March, where she placed 74th in the all-around.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Results for the World Cup Sofia 2026 |url=https://seikosportslink.com/gygr/206/?i=20010081&l=en |access-date=2026-08-31 |website=Seiko Sportslink}}</ref> In May, she competed at the [[2026 Rhythmic Gymnastics European Cup|European Cup]] in [[Baku]], finishing 39th all-around.<ref>{{Cite web |title=European Cup Baku 2026 |url=https://www.gymnastics.sport/site/events/detail.php?id=18492#loaded |access-date=2026-08-31 |website=World Gymnastics}}</ref> At the end of May, she competed at the [[2026 Rhythmic Gymnastics European Championships|European Championships]] in [[Varna, Bulgaria|Varna]], placing 66th in the all-around.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Results for the 2026 Rhythmic Gymnastics European Championships Varna |url=https://results.smartscoring.com/live-results/72a9702b-37ce-4838-82e2-f717574b5b10/result |access-date=2026-08-31 |website=SmartScoring}}</ref> She then competed at the [[Milan]] [[2026 FIG Rhythmic Gymnastics World Cup series|World Cup]] in July, finishing 76th all-around.<ref>{{Cite web |title=World Cup Milan 2026 |url=https://www.gymnastics.sport/site/events/detail.php?id=17925#loaded |access-date=2026-08-31 |website=World Gymnastics}}</ref> In August she participated to the [[2026 Rhythmic Gymnastics World Championships|2026 World Championships]] in [[Frankfurt|Frankfurt am Main]], finishing 69th in the all-around and getting her best score with ribbon.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Results for the 2026 Rhythmic Gymnastics World Championships Frankfurt am Main |url=https://live.gymnastics.sport/schedule.php?idevent=17544 |access-date=2026-08-31 |website=World Gymnastics}}</ref>
